objectClass.notes: An enclosed vendor cart on two bicycle wheels and two casters. The bicycle wheels are the mechanisms: each is a named pivot on its axle. The door is part of the cabinet shell at two draw calls, and nothing attaches, so there are no sockets. Every soi mouth at dusk. Rusting silver angle frame, dark green panels, a stainless top worn to brushed grey, a broth well with a ladle, chrome bicycle wheels on one end.

reasoning: ONE cabinet merge -- the green sheet body, the silver angle frame 6 mm proud of it, the stainless counter, the broth well as two lathes, the door and handle, a divider bead, a rust line, two casters, the axle, two tube push handles and the ladle -- and ONE InstancedMesh of two bicycle wheels: TWO draw calls of 2.

One material of the two allowed: white steel with every tone a vertex colour -- silver, dark green (lifted to #4a504d for the hole gate), stainless, broth, tyre black, rust. The registry description's "glazed side panel" is the plate's dark painted panel; no transparent state is needed.
One repetition system: two bicycle wheels off one three-cylinder geometry, each a named pivot.
Action readiness: two hinge pivots on the bicycle wheels, one box collider, zero sockets, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is an enclosed dark cabinet in a silver frame under a stainless counter with a round well and a ladle, on two big bicycle wheels; the wheels have to be real discs on the push axis or the cart reads as a cupboard.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 1.50 x 1.50 x 0.75 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=2000 triangles, <=2 draw calls, <=2 materials, <=4 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 2 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-silver (0.86) at #9c9a94 sd 11 and region-green (0.88) at #313433 sd 3; carried as vertex colours on a WHITE material: silver #a9a7a1, green LIFTED to #4a504d (luma 79 against the backdrop 58, a 21-level margin), stainless #c4c2bc, broth #a08a68 off region-broth #877762, tyre #2a2927, rust #8a5a30.
Textureless as DECLARED: a 256 px grime canvas after construction. Double-sided so the broth well interior shades.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the medium class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: One component and one repetition system: 2 of 2.

materials.note: steel only: 1 of 2; every tone a vertex colour.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 1,332 of 2,000: twenty-two boxes, two 20-segment lathes, two caster cylinders, three tubes, and a three-cylinder wheel instanced twice.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Boxes for the cabinet, frame, counter, door and casters; lathes for the well and broth; tubes for the handles and ladle; cylinders for the wheels.
One InstancedMesh: two bicycle wheels, each a named pivot with its instance index.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
The material is declared textureless. One 256 px grime canvas after construction, 0.25 MB.
